page.overview:
Who is Sickness Devil?

The の|Byōki no Akuma}} is a Devil who embodies the concept of sicknesses.

The Sickness Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Sickness Devil's personality is currently unknown.

The Sickness Devil is first mentioned by Barem Bridge when he stated that fear of Chainsaw Man had reached a level comparable to fears associated with concepts such as aging and sickness.
